MODEL STACK
==========================
Base model : Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v1.3_int8  (ref2v fine-tune)
LoRA       : minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1   strength 1.0
Sampling   : BasicScheduler (beta, adjustable steps) + euler
Mode       : SINGLE pass  — one sampling pass, no second pass

* Singularity pairs with the 4-step v0.1 LoRA only. Don't swap in the 8-step LoRA.
* Singularity is a reference-to-video specialist. For plain image-to-video,
  use a hybrid base model instead.

H3 LONG TAKE — Motion Context V2 (local)
==========================================

SAMPLING
  sampling_mode = single     <- NOT dual. This is the whole trick.
  Tested: continuing a chain off dual-pass latents gives pixel shift at
  the joins. Single pass joins clean. For long takes, always single.
  1st_pass_only / disable_2nd_noise only affect the second pass.
  In single mode they do nothing — leave them.

STEPS (green BasicScheduler node)
  8   default. Dancing, fast hands, busy backgrounds, walking + talking
  6   low motion: talking head, slow walk, locked camera
  4   runs, but dialogue drops syllables. Only with no speech.

RESOLUTION
  1.0 MP  fast, safe default for iteration
  1.4 MP  up to ~10 s per segment on a 24-32 GB card
  Past ~1.2-1.4 MP you mostly buy size, not detail.
  VRAM rule of thumb: frames x megapixels <= ~540 per segment.

MULTI-TRACK EDITOR
  Segment 1 = "shot".  Every later segment = "context".
  ref_image_size = max
  Put the reference image on segment 1 -> hover it -> Share icon ->
  "Use as shared reference". Later segments inherit it automatically.

PROJECT SETTINGS (Multi-Track Project node)
  project_name          always name it (empty = "default")
  segment_start_number  counts from 1
  segment_count         -1 = from start segment to the end
  Re-render ONE segment: start = N, count = 1  (local only —
  the saved context latents live in output/easy_media/projects/<name>/)

PROMPTS
  - A context segment's timestamps land ~0.92 s early in the final
    video (22 pinned frames are trimmed). Write T + 0.92 to land at T.
  - Open every context segment with CONTINUATION only — same pace,
    same camera, same light — and zero scenery nouns.
  - Never carry a progressive camera move across a join.
  - Put joins mid-walk / mid-climb, never on a doorway or threshold.
  - Dialogue: ~one short line every 2.5 s. Split between sentences.
